description: This file defines the 'Node' class in the Twig templating engine, representing a node in the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST). It includes methods for managing child nodes, attributes, source context, and deprecation handling.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the Twig Abstract Syntax Tree (AST), with capabilities for managing child nodes, attributes, source context, and deprecation warnings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Node with optional child nodes, attributes, line number, and deprecated tag parameter.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node, including its class, tag, attributes, and child nodes.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node using the provided Compiler object by subcompiling each child node.

methods.name: getTemplateLine
methods.description: Returns the line number associated with the node.

methods.name: getNodeTag
methods.description: Returns the tag associated with the node, if any.

methods.name: setNodeTag
methods.description: Sets the tag for the node; only allowed once.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an attribute exists in the node.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified attribute, with optional deprecation warning.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified attribute, with optional deprecation warning.

methods.name: deprecateAttribute
methods.description: Marks an attribute as deprecated with a deprecation policy.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute from the node.

methods.name: hasNode
methods.description: Checks if a child node exists by name.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves a child node by name, with deprecation warning if applicable.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Sets a child node by name, with deprecation warning if applicable, and sets source context if available.

methods.name: removeNode
methods.description: Removes a child node by name.

methods.name: deprecateNode
methods.description: Marks a child node as deprecated with a deprecation policy.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of child nodes.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over child nodes.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template source, if available.

methods.name: setSourceContext
methods.description: Sets the source context for the node and all child nodes.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context of the node.
